claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap but doesn’t work and needs repair.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows an LG front-loading washer-dryer with model text “DirectDrive 6/3kg” and a plugged-in power cable, but no test, no error codes, and no operation results were shown.

claims.claim: It is an LG DirectDrive 6/3kg front-loading washer-dryer (2-in-1).
claims.evidence: Witness report: LG logo visible; brand/model text “DirectDrive 6/3kg” visible; large round glass door; front-loading washer-dryer front view.

risks.risk: Not actually functional (wash cycle may not run, or dryer/heating may be dead).
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running a wash cycle and showing the display/program progress (and a dryer/heating test if available).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-working/needs repair (worst case) until a run-test proves otherwise.

risks.risk: Hidden drum/rubber seal issues (rust, stains, torn door gasket) that can cause leaks or poor performance.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drum interior and the rubber door seal (including edges) plus a leak check while running.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing seal/drum work (worst case) until inspected.

risks.risk: Dryer heating element failure or vent/heating faults (common in washer-dryers).
risks.proof: A clip showing dryer mode starting and the drum warming up (or an error code if it fails).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as dryer not working (worst case) until heating is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Water inlet/drain/pump/filter problems or leaks (hoses, pump, clogged filter).
risks.proof: Photos of hoses/pump area (if accessible) and a short drain/spin test showing no leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing plumbing/pump service (worst case) until drain/spin is tested.

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage that may indicate rough handling (front panel dents, door area damage) affecting resale value.
risks.proof: More angles: left/right side, back, and a close-up of the door frame and lower front panel damage/scuffs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with cosmetic wear assumed (worst case) based on visible scuffing.

proof_requests: Send a video of the machine running a full wash cycle (start to completion) with the display/error codes visible.
Send a video of dryer mode starting and confirm heating (or show any error code).
Provide close-up photos of the drum interior and the rubber door seal (edges included).
Show a drain/spin test clip with no leaks (and confirm water inlet/drain hoses condition).
Provide photos of the back and sides for dents/scratches and any missing parts/accessories/manual.
response.reason: The witness confirms the LG DirectDrive 6/3kg washer-dryer appearance, but there is no proof of whether it works or what exactly is faulty. Without a run-test/error-code evidence, a worst-case price would be guesswork beyond what the report supports.
